hero.header: I'm an offensive security Student based in Rabat, Morocco. The job is easy to describe and hard to do: get in the way a real attacker would, prove what it costs, then hand over the exact path so it can be closed for good.

mttdlrt0wmulv1.title: Kerberoasting an Attack Path to Domain Admin in a Two-Domain Forest
mttdlrt0wmulv1.excerpt: A lab write-up walking a defender through how a weak service-account password becomes a full-domain compromise — and exactly which controls and detections break the chain. Mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
